entries.source: জরুরি সহায়তা ও নিরাপত্তা | আপনার নিহোন
entries.target: Emergency Help and Safety | আপনার নিহোন

entries.source: 110, 119, lost property, hospital, earthquake, typhoon ও emergency bag—জাপানে বিপদের সময় কী করবেন তা স্পষ্ট গাইড।
entries.target: 110, 119, lost property, hospitals, earthquakes, typhoons and emergency bags—a clear guide to what to do in danger in Japan.
What to say first on the phone

entries.source: কী হয়েছে → কোথায় → কয়জন → আপনার নাম/ফোন। Location না জানলে nearby building, station, shop sign বা map address পড়ুন।
entries.target: What happened → where → how many people → your name/phone. If you don't know the location, read out a nearby building, station, shop sign or map address.

entries.source: আমি বেশি জাপানি বলতে পারি না।

entries.target: I would like an English interpreter.
Do not hang up the call

entries.source: Operator প্রশ্ন করবে। Location sharing/GPS চালু রাখুন এবং নির্দেশ না দেওয়া পর্যন্ত line-এ থাকুন।
entries.target: The operator will ask questions. Keep location sharing/GPS on and stay on the line until told otherwise.
What to do if you lose something
If you lose it on a train/at a station, station staff

entries.source: Line, train time, car number, ওঠা/নামা station, item color বলুন। Receipt/serial থাকলে দেখান।
entries.target: State the line, train time, car number, boarding/alighting station and the item's colour. If you have a receipt/serial, show it.

entries.source: রাস্তা বা public place-এ হারালে Koban
entries.target: If you lose it on the street or in a public place, a Koban

entries.source: 交番（こうばん） বা police station-এ 遺失届（いしつとどけ） করুন।
entries.target: File a 遺失届（いしつとどけ） at a 交番（こうばん） or police station.
If you lose your phone, remote lock

entries.source: Find My Device/Find My iPhone, SIM suspension, payment app lock ও police report করুন।
entries.target: Use Find My Device/Find My iPhone, suspend the SIM, lock payment apps and make a police report.
If you lose your Residence Card, act quickly

entries.source: Police report-এর পর Immigration reissuance procedure অনুসরণ করুন; official deadline আছে।
entries.target: After the police report, follow the Immigration reissuance procedure; there is an official deadline.
I left it inside the train.
I would like to file a lost property report.

entries.source: শ্বাস নিতে না পারা, অচেতন, গুরুতর রক্তপাত, severe injury ইত্যাদিতে দেরি করবেন না।
entries.target: Do not delay for inability to breathe, unconsciousness, severe bleeding, severe injury, etc.

entries.source: Department search করুন: 内科 internal medicine, 外科 surgery, 歯科 dental, 皮膚科 dermatology।
entries.target: Search by department: 内科 internal medicine, 外科 surgery, 歯科 dental, 皮膚科 dermatology.
Write down your symptoms and show them

entries.source: কখন শুরু, কোথায় ব্যথা, fever, allergy, current medicine—phone note-এ রাখুন।
entries.target: Keep in a phone note: when it started, where it hurts, fever, allergies, current medicine.
I have chest pain and difficulty breathing.
I have had a fever for three days.
I am allergic to this medicine.

entries.source: মাথা ঢাকুন, নিচু হন, শক্ত table-এর নিচে
entries.target: Cover your head, crouch down, under a sturdy table

entries.source: আগুন/গ্যাস check, official alert, safe route
entries.target: Check for fire/gas, official alerts, safe routes

entries.source: ধোঁয়ার নিচে থেকে exit; lift নয়
entries.target: Stay below the smoke to exit; not the lift
To high ground away from the sea/river mouths

entries.source: Official all-clear না হওয়া পর্যন্ত ফিরবেন না
entries.target: Do not return until there is an official all-clear
Learn the language of evacuation levels
Basic preparation for at least 3 days
Depending on the person and situation

entries.source: Passport, Residence Card, insurance, contact ও address—waterproof pouch-এ copy।
entries.target: Copies of passport, Residence Card, insurance, contacts and address—in a waterproof pouch.
Small notes/coins, a flashlight, batteries, a whistle.

entries.source: বড় দুর্যোগে Disaster Emergency Message Dial 171 চালু হতে পারে; voice prompt Japanese। আগে family plan ঠিক করুন।
entries.target: In a major disaster, the Disaster Emergency Message Dial 171 may be activated; voice prompts are in Japanese. Decide a family plan in advance.

entries.source: Phone lock screen বা wallet-এ রাখুন
entries.target: Keep it on your phone lock screen or in your wallet
If you don't have one, なし
I have memorised/saved 110, 119 and my own address
I have saved my school/company emergency contact

entries.source: Nearest hospital, koban ও shelter map-এ save করেছি
entries.target: I have saved the nearest hospital, koban and shelter on a map
I have prepared an emergency bag

entries.source: Phone remote-find ও lock চালু করেছি
entries.target: I have turned on phone remote-find and lock

entries.source: Family-এর সঙ্গে disaster contact plan করেছি
entries.target: I have made a disaster contact plan with my family
I have kept copies of my Residence Card/passport safely

entries.source: নিয়ম পরিবর্তন হতে পারে—শেষ সিদ্ধান্তের আগে অফিসিয়াল তথ্য দেখুন
entries.target: Rules may change—check official information before final decisions

entries.source: এই গাইড শেখার সহায়ক। ব্যক্তিগত আইনগত/চিকিৎসাগত সিদ্ধান্তে সংশ্লিষ্ট অফিস বা পেশাদারের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করুন।
